name: a confidence threshold slider moves the included total
looks: A settings panel holds a single slider labelled by how sure the system should be before it bills automatically. As the handle slides along its track, a dollar figure above it recalculates live, and a short breakdown beside it splits into what's billed automatically, what's sent to a person, and what's blocked.
build: The slider's handle x and the dollar figure are driven off one clock value (power2.inOut); the three-way breakdown's values key off the same value so all four numbers move in lockstep, same mechanic as slider-scrub-preview.
sound: A soft tick per slider step and a light shimmer as the numbers resolve.
prompt: Show a settings panel with a single confidence-threshold slider; as the handle moves, have a dollar figure above it recalculate live along with a short breakdown of what gets billed automatically, sent to a person, or blocked, so the one slider visibly controls the system's caution.
